You come home after 11 days. The smell of the cookfire does something to your chest you don't examine. "You're thinner," someone says. "You're still here," you say.
While you were gone — 8 things you missed:
⚔️ Tashi killed the humming in the grass alone — 1 round, 6 taken. Word travels fast. The village cheers.
⚔️ Tao killed the Hummice alone — 1 round, 15 taken. Word travels fast. The village cheers.
⚔️ Dakota killed the Flashbulb Moth alone — 2 rounds, 19 taken. Word travels fast. The village cheers.
⚔️ Darmi stood down the Hushpuppy and kept walking — 3 rounds, bloodied but breathing. It's still out there, somewhere.
⚔️ Tashi killed the Hummice alone — 1 round, 7 taken. Word travels fast. The village cheers.
...and 3 more. Ask around — they'll tell you.

That night at the fire, they ask where you've been. You tell them — and what you learned out there: Loquat. Someone leans closer to the light. "Show us. Slowly." The knowledge is home now. It'll get around.

You start in on American Hazelnut, Asian Persimmon, Purslane, Camu-camu, Tulsi (Holy Basil), Gum Acacia, European Hazelnut, Prickly Pear, Biriba, Giant Water Lily too — and they grin. "Old news, friend. Tao showed us that one." Still: you carried it home. That's the job.
💬 The village saw the sky split.
You were out when it happened. When you return, everyone's talking at once. Ethan is crying. Yara is laughing. Nikolai hasn't said a word.
Tashi: "The sky just... opened. And something talked to us. It said it was sorry. SORRY for what?!"
Nora: "It offered me something. A... gift? I said no. I don't trust gifts from the sky."
Yara: "..." (Yara hasn't spoken since it happened.)
The village looks to you. You're the scholar. You're supposed to know things.
